detail: workflow_ops has NO op that creates/moves/deletes groups; groups and extra injected into the base workflow pass through the whole op stream untouched (only `clear` empties groups). The op vocabulary cannot express group edits.
`clear` empties nodes, links, and groups but NOT `extra` and NOT definitions.subgraphs; last_node_id/last_link_id are preserved by design (id-reuse guard). _widget_stamps also survive a clear.

Only set_widget is subgraph-scoped in the frozen vocabulary. connect refuses interior endpoints (a link cannot cross the subgraph boundary) and promoted widgets (value, not link input); delete_node/add_node cannot address interior nodes at all. Interior set_widget ops carry the resolved `path` + `inner_widget`; flat (`57.text`), nested (`57/27.text`) and flattened (`57:27.text`) forms normalize to one write target.

probes.connect-to-interior: node 57/27 is inside subgraph 57 ('Text to Image') — a link cannot cross the subgraph boundary, so connect cannot reach it. Interior widgets ARE settable: `comfy workflow set-widget <file> 57/27.<widget> <value>`. To wire a live link, connect to one of the instance's own slots (see `comfy workflow slots`), or promote the input in the ComfyUI editor first.
probes.connect-to-promoted-widget: input 'text' on subgraph instance 57 is a promoted widget (a value), not a link input — set it with `comfy workflow set-widget <file> 57.text <value>`. Wiring a live link into the subgraph requires promoting a link input in the ComfyUI editor.
